note: Living map of the AI-gateway / model-routing layer. Facts cross-checked from public 2026 sources; deal figures reflect reported ranges and are labeled.
moves: Stripe agreed to acquire OpenRouter — a reported $7B+ (sources range $7–10B), ~5× its $1.3B valuation from 3 months earlier. Signed, closing expected in weeks.
Palo Alto Networks acquired Portkey (closed May 2026) — folded into its Prisma AIRS agent-security product.
Databricks reportedly bid for OpenRouter, lost, and shipped its own Unity AI Gateway.
Vercel and Ramp launched their own gateways; Cloudflare and Kong keep shipping.

segments.label: Independent gateways & routers
segments.blurb: Startups whose whole product is the routing/observability/spend layer between apps and models. Two of the biggest just got acquired.

gateways.name: OpenRouter
gateways.does: Model marketplace + unified API over 500+ models / 80+ providers; routing, fallback, unified billing

gateways.name: Portkey
gateways.does: AI gateway + observability, guardrails, caching, fallback — now agent security/governance
gateways.note: Closed May 2026; folded into Prisma AIRS

gateways.name: LiteLLM
gateways.does: Open-source unified API/proxy across 100+ providers; self-host or managed

gateways.name: Kong AI Gateway
gateways.does: API-gateway incumbent extended for LLM traffic; open-sourced AI Gateway

gateways.name: TrueFoundry
gateways.does: Enterprise AI gateway + MCP gateway + ML infra

gateways.name: Martian
gateways.does: Model-routing research; now positioned as a research org more than a product

gateways.name: Unify
gateways.does: Started as an LLM router; pivoted to AI agent teammates

gateways.name: Sapiom
gateways.does: Agent cost-routing to cheapest capable model (covered in Proof of Stack)

segments.label: Platform-owned gateways
segments.blurb: Dev-platforms and data clouds bundling a gateway to keep builders inside their ecosystem.

gateways.name: Vercel AI Gateway
gateways.does: Unified model access inside the Vercel/AI-SDK stack; fallback, observability, public model leaderboards
gateways.note: In beta; publishes a production model index

gateways.name: Databricks Unity AI Gateway
gateways.does: Model serving + gateway + agent governance inside the data platform
gateways.note: Shipped after reportedly losing the OpenRouter bid

gateways.name: Bedrock / Azure AI / Vertex
gateways.does: Hyperscaler model access layers with routing/guardrails

segments.label: Edge / CDN players
segments.blurb: CDN incumbents moving up-stack — inference at the edge, gateways at the network layer.

gateways.name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
gateways.does: Gateway with caching, analytics, rate-limiting; pairs with Workers AI inference

segments.label: Payments / fintech-owned
segments.blurb: The surprise entrants — payments and spend platforms owning the metering layer. Whoever owns the meter owns the margin.

gateways.name: Stripe (via OpenRouter)
gateways.does: Model gateway folded into a payments giant — metering + billing for AI tokens
gateways.note: Collison: 'Tokens are the central currency for AI'

gateways.name: Ramp
gateways.does: Launched its own LLM gateway (spend-management angle)
